item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a bar magnet hanging from a thread so it can turn freely, away from other magnets. After it settles, Sonia marks the end that points toward geographic north.

What has she found?

options.A: North–south direction; the marked end is the North pole of the magnet.
options.B: East–west direction; the marked end is the South pole of the magnet.
options.C: North–south direction while the magnet is still swinging.
options.D: A direction that any ordinary iron bar would show the same way when hung.
